params.refused_phase_note: refused shape on go-redis v9.22.0: phase 1 (budget_expiry_dial_retrying, class timeout) — queuedNewConn runs the dial on a detached context (internal/pool/pool.go:1059) so the caller budget aborts only the wait while dialConn keeps retrying (DialerRetries default 5 x 100ms backoff, pool.go:707/782 ≈ 0.4-0.5s > L); phase 2 (dial_error_fast_path, class refused) — once dialErrorsNum saturates, dialConn short-circuits to the cached refused error (pool.go:692, bookkeeping pool.go:765, background tryDial probe resets only on success pool.go:806-830). Both are ErrUnavailable; no timing bound is weakened.
params.lower_bound_note: duration >= L/2 asserted for dial_blackhole/cold_init/hot_blocked (guards a spurious instant failure); refused has no lower bound
params.parent_ctx: context.Background with a 10m test deadline, so min(parent, L) = L for every sample
